draft.title: Simple machines
card: A simple machine is a tool that makes a job easier by changing the size or the direction of the force you need to use.
Lever
a rigid bar that turns around a fixed point called the pivot. A crowbar lets you lift a heavy rock with a small push.
Pulley
a wheel with a rope around it. A single fixed pulley on a flagpole changes the direction of the force, so you pull down to raise the flag.
Inclined plane
a ramp. Pushing a heavy box up a ramp takes less force than lifting it straight up, though the box travels a longer path.
draft.remember: Simple machines change the size or direction of the force needed for a job.

a.q: Sam pulls down on a rope over a fixed pulley to raise a bucket. How does the pulley help?
opts: It changes the direction of the force
It makes the bucket lighter
It turns the pull into a push
It makes the bucket's path shorter
a.why: The rope runs over the wheel, so a downward pull lifts the bucket upward. The bucket does not become lighter, and a single fixed pulley does not shorten the path.
a.clue: Think about which way Sam pulls and which way the bucket moves.

b.q: Priya needs to get a heavy barrel onto a truck tray. She rolls it up a plank instead of lifting it. Which simple machine is the plank, and how does it help?
opts: An inclined plane, so she needs less force
A lever, so she needs less force
An inclined plane, so the barrel travels a shorter path
A pulley, so she pushes in a different direction
b.why: A plank leaning against a truck is a ramp, which is an inclined plane. Rolling the barrel up it takes less force than lifting it, but the barrel travels a longer path, so the option about a shorter path is wrong.
b.clue: A ramp trades a smaller force for a longer path.

a.best: It changes the direction of the force

b.best: An inclined plane, so she needs less force

problems.detail: The clue 'A ramp trades a smaller force for a longer path' all but states the answer. It tells students the plank is a ramp and rules out the 'shorter path' option, so they can choose without knowing that a ramp is an inclined plane.

check.summary: The card, remember line and both questions are accurate, and each question has one right answer. The clue for question b nearly gives the answer away by calling the plank a ramp that needs a smaller force.
